title: Riex NU80 (19mm) Concealed slide, full extension, soft-close, synchro, 40 kg, 300 mm, 3D brackets
description: Concealed drawer slide with mounting under the drawer bottom for all-wood drawers with soft closing function. The drawer is equipped with a synchronisation mechanism for smooth operation of the individual slide segments. The total load capacity including the weight of the drawer is 40 kg, at this load the drawer has a very good durability for many years. The length of the extension is the same as the length of the drawer (it is a full extension). The slides are connected to the drawer with brackets that allow the drawer front to be adjusted vertically (up and down), horizontally (left and right) and also gap between the front and cabinet can be adjusted. Thickness of side panels of drawer can be up to 19mm.

title: Riex NC70 Hinge clip on, 45°, soft-close
description: Furniture cup angle hinge 45° with soft-closing.  The hinge is equipped with a lever shaped casted clip mechanism for easy detachment from the plate. The hinge arm is equipped with a round sunk CAM screw with a large adjusting range for easy adjustment of the gap between the cabinet and the door. The hinge is equipped with a steel damper that is capable of absorbing even a very dynamically closing door. The door has a 45° angle to the normal hinge when closed, so it is suitable for various types of corner cabinets.

title: Riex NC70 Hinge clip on, 90°, soft-close

The hinge is equipped with a steel damper that is capable of absorbing even a very dynamically closing door. The door has a 90° angle to the normal hinge when closed (the door is parallel to the cabinet), so it is suitable for various types of cabinets with frame.
